title: Shop Till You Drop
theme: Disney merchandise, pins, ear hats and souvenirs
intro: [excited] Wallets out, everybody! Tonight is all about Disney souvenirs: ear hats, spirit jerseys, trading pins and popcorn buckets. [laughs] Exit through the gift shop, please!

art.prompt: A glowing theme park gift shop window at dusk overflowing with souvenirs: rows of round-eared hats on display stands, colorful sweatshirts on hangers, a corkboard of sparkly enamel pins and towers of novelty popcorn buckets Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Collectible Toys
categories.intro: Before you buy toys at the parks, meet the most famous toys in movie history. [chuckles] It's Toy Story time!

art.prompt: A child's bedroom floor at night with a cowboy hat, a toy rocket, a plush teddy bear that smells sweet, an antique shop sign-free display cabinet and a glowing claw machine Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: In Toy Story 2, greedy Al plans to sell Woody to a toy museum in this country.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Japan! Woody was headed to a museum in Tokyo. [laughs] Not without Andy!

clues.clue: Woody's Roundup gang includes Jessie, Stinky Pete and this loyal horse.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Bullseye! [chuckles] Ride like the wind, Bullseye!

clues.clue: In Toy Story, Buzz Lightyear first learns he's a toy when he sees a TV ad for this toy store.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Al's Toy Barn! [laughs] Not a flying toy. A falling-with-style toy.

clues.clue: Lotso, the bear in charge of Sunnyside Daycare in Toy Story 3, smells like this fruit.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is strawberries! [whispers] Sweet smell, sour bear. Don't trust him.

clues.clue: In Toy Story 4, Woody finds Gabby Gabby at this antique store.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is Second Chance Antiques! That's where the creepy dummies live. True Toy Story nerd points!

categories.title: Souvenir Silhouettes
categories.intro: Look at these souvenir pictures and name what you see. [chuckles] Don't buy anything yet!

art.prompt: A sunny souvenir shop shelf with mystery items covered by silky sheets, lit by a spotlight, with price tags dangling Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This classic black souvenir hat has two big round ears. Kids have worn them since the 1950s.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Mickey Mouse ears! [laughs] Ears up, everybody!

media.prompt: A classic black felt beanie cap with two large round black ears attached on top, sitting on a wooden shop counter, warm studio lighting Original artwork, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This roomy long-sleeved shirt with arched lettering on the front is a huge Disney fan favorite. It's called this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a spirit jersey! [chuckles] Comfy, colorful and in about a hundred shades.

media.prompt: An oversized pastel lavender long-sleeve crewneck sweatshirt laid flat on a white table, with blank arched decorative stitching across the chest and dropped shoulders Original artwork, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This wearable band, introduced at Walt Disney World in 2013, can be your park ticket and hotel room key.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is MagicBand! Tap and go. [laughs] It's magic on your wrist.

media.prompt: A colorful rubber wristband with a small round sensor disc in the middle, resting on a turnstile beside a glowing circular reader light Original artwork, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: These crank machines squash a coin into an oval souvenir with a picture on it. Name the souvenir.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is pressed pennies! [chuckles] Fifty cents plus a penny. The best cheap souvenir in the park.

media.prompt: An old-fashioned brass penny-pressing machine with a big crank handle, and a few stretched oval copper coins scattered on a velvet tray Original artwork, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Before 1982, Disneyland's most thrilling rides needed this top-level ticket from a ticket book.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is the E-ticket! It's why people still call a great ride an E-ticket ride. True Disney nerd points!

media.prompt: A vintage paper ticket booklet from the 1960s, with colorful perforated coupons in a row from cheapest to fanciest, a blank top coupon glowing, on an old wooden ticket booth counter Original artwork, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Ears to You
categories.intro: Ear hats are the most iconic Disney souvenir. [laughs] Let's hear it for the ears!

art.prompt: A long wall display of colorful ear headbands in every color and sparkle, glowing ears in the middle, and a sewing machine with spools of thread Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: The first Mickey ears were worn by kids called Mouseketeers on this 1950s TV show.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is The Mickey Mouse Club! M-I-C, see you real soon! [laughs] It debuted in 1955.

clues.clue: Minnie Mouse ears usually come with this accessory on top.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a bow! [chuckles] Polka dots are optional, but highly recommended.

clues.clue: At some Disney shops, cast members will stitch this onto the back of your classic ear hat for free or a small fee.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is your name! [laughs] That way nobody steals your ears.

clues.clue: In 2012, Disney California Adventure sold light-up ears that sync with the World of Color show, called this.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Glow with the Show ears! The ears change color with the music. [laughs] Very futuristic.

clues.clue: The original Mouseketeer ears were created by this Disney artist known as the Big Mooseketeer.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is Roy Williams! He was a Disney animator and storyman. True Disney nerd points!

categories.title: Pin Trading Post
categories.intro: Disney pin trading is a whole sport. [laughs] Trade you a question for an answer!

art.prompt: A corkboard and a long cord lanyard covered in shiny enamel pins of castles, stars, rockets and hearts, with a magnifying glass and a pin backing on the table Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Cast members wear pins for trading on this kind of neck cord.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is a lanyard! [chuckles] Just ask a cast member to see their pins.

clues.clue: Official Disney pin trading began at Walt Disney World in this year, during the Millennium Celebration.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1999! [laughs] Pins went crazy for Y2K.

clues.clue: Cast-member-only pins with a tiny Mickey head icon on the front are called these kind of pins.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hidden Mickey pins! [whispers] Look for the little Mickey head icon.

clues.clue: Pin traders call fake or unauthorized Disney pins by this name.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is scrappers! [sighs] Watch out for weird colors and messy edges.

clues.clue: Many genuine Disney pins have a pattern of tiny Mickey heads on the back with this breakfast-food name.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is a waffle pattern! It's a sign the pin is official. True pin-trader points!

categories.title: Shop Talk
categories.intro: The fan side of Disney shopping, from giant stores to viral buckets. [laughs] Add to cart!

art.prompt: A huge flagship gift shop interior with towering shelves of plush toys, mini backpacks on hooks and a glowing purple popcorn bucket on a spotlit pedestal Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This giant store at Disney Springs is one of the largest Disney stores in the world.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is World of Disney! [laughs] Bring an extra bag. Or three.

clues.clue: This brand's mini backpacks and wallets are a huge hit with Disney fans.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Loungefly! [chuckles] Fans collect them like trading pins.

clues.clue: The very first Disney Store opened in 1987 inside a shopping mall in this Southern California city.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Glendale! The Glendale Galleria. [laughs] Right near Walt Disney Imagineering's headquarters.

clues.clue: In 2024, a popcorn bucket of this little purple dragon from Epcot became a viral, hard-to-get souvenir.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Figment! [laughs] One little spark, and a lot of internet memes. Fans waited hours.

clues.clue: In 2017, this shiny pinkish metallic color became a huge Disney merch trend, appearing on Minnie ears and more.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is rose gold! [chuckles] Rose gold ears were everywhere. True fashionista points!
